reviews.title: Inexpensive and effective
reviews.comment:
It's a solid, cheap little fan that's great for working on new systems and making sure everything POSTs. Kept it around in case my AIO ever fails and I need a fan to tide me over while I wait for my new AIO.
Wouldn't use it long-term on anything beefier than an i3, but it's cheap and it works!
